inputs.text: This whole Liberal split is nothing but a staged distraction from the elites to bury what really matters. Angus Taylor has clearly moved to shut down Andrew Hastie’s push for even considering higher taxes on gas companies and rolling back those concessions for property investors. They want everyone to swallow the line that it's some philosophy clash with the opposition leader, but that's just the cover to shield the big interests raking in the profits from those breaks. The opposition leader also refused to back Hastie’s criticism of Donald Trump or say whether he endorsed the US and Israel’s war with Iran. That kind of silence is never random—it’s the elites coordinating to keep the narrative locked down and prevent any real pressure from building.
